name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.191.0 — The AskUserQuestion style gate's model judge no longer blocks: it allows the question and returns its verdict to the session as advice. The judge is non-deterministic — one identical question measured one rewrite, six passes, and one silent no-output in eight runs — so a blocking verdict trapped sessions in a loop no rewrite could clear, and the escape (deciding in prose outside the tool) is a dismissed question that stops the run. A false derive verdict was worse still, instructing the session to invent an answer the user never gave. The deterministic tier-1 floor still blocks. Merge strategy is now derived from the driver's own recommendation instead of asked, per the two-lens filter: it has no product consequence and its delivery consequence is already in the printed history. 7.190.0 — The retired HTML design atlas — the whole-product design script, the components duplicate checker, eighteen browser and notes libraries under scripts/lib, the chrome mocks, and the design templates behind them — is deleted outright, along with the command that served it and the spec-paths keys that named it; genesis's no-mock-app skeleton branch drops the HTML checks that used to spawn them (the components duplicate check, the shell check, the shell-stamp check, and the mocks matrix check), so a host with no mock app lands the skeleton with no HTML-design checks; docs/canonical/scripts.md and genesis.md are reworded to name the survivor alone. 7.189.0 — Genesis, the run design stage and /spec:sketch read the mock app instead of HTML mocks: the grounding contract's design block is just { app }, the design stage is preflight → reconcile → look → stamp over approved, hash-current screens, genesis auto-picks the frontend and skips the scaffold tournament when a mock app exists and lands the skeleton on mock-review check, /spec:init stops offering frontend-design, and the old render step and the design AC reconciliation script are deleted.
